license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to profess to be a podiatrist, to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatry without first obtaining from the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure a license authorizing the practice of podiatry in this state

issuing_authority.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure shall examine all applicants as hereinafter provided in this chapter.

name.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure shall examine all applicants as hereinafter provided in this chapter.

type.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure shall examine all applicants as hereinafter provided in this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: All applicants for license shall have attained the age of twenty-one (21) years

moral_character_required.quote: All applicants for license shall have attained the age of twenty-one (21) years, and shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: Graduate of a college of podiatry recognized as being in good standing by the State Board of Medical Licensure, requiring a course of study of at least four (4) years
degree_required.quote: they shall have at least one (1) year prepodiatry college education and be graduates of some college of podiatry recognized as being in good standing by the State Board of Medical Licensure. No college of podiatry or chiropody shall be accredited by the board as a college of good standing that does not require for graduation a course of study of at least four (4) years (eight and one-half (8-1/2) months each)

exams.name: State Board of Medical Licensure examination
exams.notes: Subjects include anatomy, histology, physiology, chemistry, pharmacy, materia medica, therapeutics, bacteriology, pathology, surgery, dermatology, neurology, physical therapy, diagnosis and roentgenology, orthopedics, chiropody and chiropodial surgery. Minimum 75% average required, not less than 60% on any single subject.
exams.quote: Any person not exempt from examination under Section 73-27-5 ... and desiring a license to practice podiatry shall, upon application to the State Board of Medical Licensure and payment of a fee ... be examined in the following subjects: anatomy, histology, physiology, chemistry, pharmacy, materia medica, therapeutics, bacteriology, pathology, surgery, dermatology, neurology, physical therapy, diagnosis and roentgenology, orthopedics, chiropody and chiropodial surgery

exams.name: National Board of Chiropody or Podiatry Licensure examination
exams.notes: The board may affiliate with the National Board of Chiropody or Podiatry Licensure, provided the written examination covers at least two-thirds of the subjects set forth in Section 73-27-9.
exams.jurisdiction: national (National Board of Chiropody or Podiatry Licensure)
exams.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may affiliate with the National Board of Chiropody or Podiatry Licensure in granting licenses to practice podiatry in Mississippi, provided the written examination covers at least two-thirds (2/3) of the subjects set forth in Section 73-27-9

interval_years.quote: the license of every person licensed to practice podiatry in the State of Mississippi shall be renewed annually

renewal_fee_usd.quote: submit it to the board in the manner prescribed by the board in the notice before June 30 with the renewal fee of an amount established by the board, but not to exceed Three Hundred Dollars ($300.00)

available.quote: Upon payment of a fee prescribed by the State Board of Medical Licensure, not to exceed Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00), a license without examination may be issued to podiatrists of other states maintaining equal statutory requirements for the practice of podiatry and extending the same reciprocal privileges to this state.

requirements.value: Reciprocity available to podiatrists of other states maintaining equal statutory requirements and extending same reciprocal privileges to Mississippi. Fee not to exceed $500. Military applicants, spouses, and persons establishing residence in Mississippi subject to Sections 73-50-1 or 73-50-2.
requirements.quote: a license without examination may be issued to podiatrists of other states maintaining equal statutory requirements for the practice of podiatry and extending the same reciprocal privileges to this state. The issuance of a license by reciprocity to a military-trained applicant, military spouse or person who establishes residence in this state shall be subject to the provisions of Section 73-50-1 or 73-50-2, as applicable.

exists.quote: There is established the Podiatry Advisory Committee to the State Board of Medical Licensure.

name.quote: There is established the Podiatry Advisory Committee to the State Board of Medical Licensure.

authority.value: The Podiatry Advisory Committee shall advise and make recommendations to the State Board of Medical Licensure on all podiatry matters that come before the board. The board shall not make any final decision or take any final action on any podiatry matter until the board has reviewed any materials or other information presented or delivered to it by the advisory committee.
authority.quote: The Podiatry Advisory Committee shall advise and make recommendations to the State Board of Medical Licensure on all podiatry matters that come before the board. disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs or other addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors to an extent affecting professional competency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors, or any beverage, to an extent which affects professional competency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing narcotic or addiction-forming drugs outside legitimate professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any narcotic drug, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability otherwise than in the course of legitimate professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of federal or state law regulating possession, distribution, or use of narcotic or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing medical diagnosis or treatment outside the scope of podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any medical diagnosis or treatment outside the scope of podiatry as defined in Section 73-27-1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner, living or dead.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisting an unlicensed person to practice podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performing any act which in any way assists an unlicensed person to practice podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making flamboyant claims concerning professional excellence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or willfully causing to be made any flamboyant claims concerning the licensee's professional excellence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonorable or unethical conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of any dishonorable or unethical conduct likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee by fraudulently representing an incurable condition can be cured or treating it by a secret method.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a fee as personal compensation or gain from a person on fraudulent representation a disease or injury condition generally considered incurable by competent medical authority in the light of current scientific knowledge and practice can be cured or offering, undertaking, attempting or agreeing to cure or treat the same by a secret method, which he refuses to divulge to the board upon request.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or forged statements or documents in connection with licensing requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any false, fraudulent or forged statement or document, or the use of any fraudulent, deceitful, dishonest or immoral practice in connection with any of the licensing requirements, including the signing in his professional capacity any certificate that is known to be false at the time he makes or signs such certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to identify podiatrist's school of practice in professional uses of name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to identify a podiatrist's school of practice in all professional uses of his name by use of his earned degree or a description of his school of practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension, or restriction of license by another state's licensing authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice podiatry in that state or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license, permit or certificate issued by such licensing authority which prevents or restricts practice in that state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being out of compliance with a child support order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall be authorized to suspend the license of any licensee for being out of compliance with an order for support, as defined in Section 93-11-153

definition_quote.value: The practice of podiatric medicine is that profession concerned with the prevention, examination, diagnosis and medical, surgical and adjuvant treatment of conditions of the human foot. For the purposes of this chapter, 'foot' means that part of the human anatomy which consists of the tarsal bones, metatarsal bones and phalanges.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine is that profession concerned with the prevention, examination, diagnosis and medical, surgical and adjuvant treatment of conditions of the human foot. For the purposes of this chapter, "foot" means that part of the human anatomy which consists of the tarsal bones, metatarsal bones and phalanges.

drug_authority.value: A podiatrist may prescribe and administer drugs and tests, excluding general and spinal anesthesia, that are essential to the practice of podiatric medicine when used for or in connection with treatment of disorders of the human foot.
